Nowhere. Matching runs in your browser and answers are stored only on this
device. There are no accounts and no tracking, and you can delete everything at
Where does the trial data come from?
ClinicalTrials.gov, the public registry. The list is prepared in advance and
downloaded once, so your searches never reach a server.
Why is a recruiting trial listed without a recruiting site?
Registries often mark a trial as recruiting overall while no nearby site says so. We
keep it, rank it lower and label it, because some are still worth asking about.
What if I do not know an answer?
Choose “I don’t know”. The trial stays in the list and the criterion is marked open.
Which conditions and countries are covered?
